data_fields.name: class_stat_weight_row
data_fields.donor_constant: six weights per class, sum about 24 (26 rows)

best_idea: Level up by three stat picks drawn from a per-class weight row (first pick uniform, the next two weighted without replacement), so a class's growth shape is a 6-number data row and no two picks repeat.
decision_why: Fits row 21 (catalogue fields): class weight rows are catalogue data and the picks are a pure engine function. Keep the weighted picks and the use-based combat skill gain (hit 1 in 10, kill 1 in 8, crystal 1 in 6); replace the per-pick bonus roll with an explicit rate; drop race multipliers until Frankendom has a race ruling.
acceptance: Server test: a level-up with weights {7,2,6,1,2,6} returns three distinct stats in every seeded trial; over 20,000 level-ups the Warrior's STR is picked most often; a 250 XP award at level 1 ends at level 3 with 50 XP; combat hits gain at 1 in 10, kills 1 in 8, crystal weapons 1 in 6, and a dummy at proficiency 20 gives no gain.
